works.author: SM Rubel
works.comment: 移动点餐 App 采用暖色卡片式布局，菜单层级与优惠入口清晰，餐饮类 App 的点单流程设计值得借鉴。
works.comment_en: Mobile ordering app in warm card-style layouts; menu hierarchy and promo entries are clear — the ordering flow is worth borrowing for food apps.
works.title: Coffee Shop App UI/UX Design – Modern Coffee Ordering App

works.author: Al Razi Siam
works.comment: 以视频演绎的房产落地页，动效与房源卡片结合自然，首屏信息层级清晰，房地产类站点可参考其首屏编排。
works.comment_en: Real-estate landing page told through video; motion blends naturally with listing cards and the first-screen hierarchy is clear — a good above-the-fold reference for property sites.
works.title: Real Estate Agency Landing Page

works.author: Phenomenon Product for Phenomenon Studio
works.comment: 能源交易平台的深色仪表盘，实时图表、资产管理与交易记录分区明确，数据密度高而不乱，金融类数据看板的优秀范例。
works.comment_en: Dark dashboard for an energy-trading platform: live charts, asset management, and trade history in clear zones — high data density without chaos, an excellent fintech dashboard example.
works.title: Energy Trading Web App Design – GridTrade

works.author: ALEX BENDER for FANCY
works.comment: 金融落地页配 3D 动画，英雄区用立体图标讲清 pre-IPO 概念，动效与留白平衡得当，值得学习其叙事节奏。
works.comment_en: Fintech landing page with 3D animation; the hero uses dimensional icons to explain the pre-IPO concept, balancing motion and whitespace well — study its narrative pacing.
works.title: IPO Gateway landing page web design 3D animation website icons

works.author: Eloqwnt
works.comment: AI 决策模拟器官网，叙事节奏出色，数据可视化卡片排布有层次，AI SaaS 官网可借鉴。
works.comment_en: AI decision-simulator site with excellent narrative pacing and layered data-viz cards — worth borrowing for AI SaaS sites.
works.title: Business Twin - Website

works.author: Jack R. for RonDesignLab
works.comment: 信用监控仪表盘采用卡片化布局，评分仪表盘与各项指标一目了然，配色克制，适合信用金融类产品借鉴。
works.comment_en: Credit-monitoring dashboard in a card layout; the score gauge and metrics read at a glance, colors restrained — a good model for credit-finance products.
works.title: Credit Karma CRM - Credit Monitoring Dashboard

works.author: Halo UI/UX for HALO LAB
works.comment: 教育平台的清爽浅色仪表盘，学习进度条与学员榜单模块清晰，雷达图呈现学习维度新颖实用。
works.comment_en: Clean light dashboard for an education platform; study progress bars and learner leaderboards are clear, and the radar chart of learning dimensions is fresh and practical.
works.title: Dashboard for Edtech Product – Learnio
